newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: There was good demand for all grades at the Calcutta tea auction this week, traders said on Friday.
In all, 23,861 packages including 2,685 packages of Darjeeling tea were on offer.
Traders said in the CTC variety there was strong demand for good Assam grades. There were export enquiries for good Assam fannings.
In the orthodox variety, export demand was strong for whole leaf grades from the Middle East and Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) countries.
There were also export enquiries for broken grades from the Middle East, traders said.
In dust grades, all varieties witnessed good demand.
